parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal offence, facility ban, border restriction or documented police targeting of trans visitors is shown, and same-sex conduct is decriminalised. Resident-facing gaps—no LGR statute, no nonbinary recognition, no documented gender-identity anti-discrimination provision—are not traveller exposures. Functioning courts and a prosecutor who reopened cases after a 2024 regional-court finding provide some recourse. However, the documented hate-crime enforcement gap and impunity, unresolved outcomes, low political salience of trans rights, and absence of sourced evidence on trans-specific police treatment, facilities, or successful protection leave material uncertainty and thin recourse if outed, placing this below tiers with documented trans acceptance and operating remedies.
